00044 SAHUGenInternal::SAHUGenInternal(UGen const& input, UGen const& trig) throw()
00045 : UGenInternal(NumInputs),
00046   currentValue(0.f),
00047   lastTrig(0.f)
00048 {
00049   inputs[Input] = input;
00050   inputs[Trig] = trig;
00051 }
00052 
00053 UGenInternal* SAHUGenInternal::getChannel(const int channel) throw()
00054 {
00055   return new SAHUGenInternal(inputs[Input].getChannel(channel), 
00056                  inputs[Trig].getChannel(channel));
00057 }
00058 
00059 void SAHUGenInternal::processBlock(bool& shouldDelete, const unsigned int blockID, const int channel) throw()
00060 {
00061   int numSamplesToProcess = uGenOutput.getBlockSize();
00062   float* outputSamples = uGenOutput.getSampleData();
00063   float* inputSamples = inputs[Input].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, channel);
00064   float* trigSamples = inputs[Trig].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, channel);
00065   
00066   while(numSamplesToProcess--)
00067   {
00068     float thisTrig = *trigSamples++;
00069     
00070     if(lastTrig <= 0.f && thisTrig > 0.f)
00071       currentValue = *inputSamples++;
00072     else
00073       inputSamples++;
00074         
00075     *outputSamples++ = currentValue;
00076     lastTrig = thisTrig;
00077   }
00078 }

00080 SAH::SAH(UGen const& input, UGen const& trig) throw()
00081 {
00082   UGen inputs[] = { input, trig };
00083   const int numInputChannels = findMaxInputChannels(numElementsInArray(inputs), inputs);
00084   initInternal(numInputChannels);
00085   
00086   for(int i = 0; i < numInternalUGens; i++)
00087   {
00088     internalUGens[i] = new SAHUGenInternal(input, trig);
00089     if(trig.getValue(i) <= 0.f)
00090       internalUGens[i]->initValue(0.f);
00091     else
00092       internalUGens[i]->initValue(input.getValue(i));   
00093   }
00094 }

00109 void ToggleFFUGenInternal::processBlock(bool& shouldDelete, const unsigned int blockID, const int channel) throw()
00110 {
00111   int numSamplesToProcess = uGenOutput.getBlockSize();
00112   float* outputSamples = uGenOutput.getSampleData();
00113   float* trigSamples = inputs[Trig].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, channel);

00121     
00122     *outputSamples++ = currentValue;
00123     lastTrig = thisTrig;
00124   }
